name: Camp Finberg
description_short: YMCA summer day camp in Norton, MA, with camp hours 8:30am-4:00pm and optional before care (from 7:00am) and after care (until 5:30pm). Families can register for 2, 3, or 5 days per week; specialty camps are 5-day only.
refund_policy_summary: To cancel a week, notify the Camp Registrar at least two weeks ahead, before that week's payment is drafted. After May 31 a $25 change fee applies to any change (weeks, camps, added care). Deposits move to other weeks. A $25 Camp Improvement Fee is non-refundable; Specialty Camps take a $100 non-refundable deposit.

swim_waterfront_notes: Outdoor eight-lane pool with a three-foot entry area and a zero-depth splash pad; recreational swim on most days, supervised by lifeguards and counselors, with a swim check before swimming without flotation or in deeper water. Express Swim Lessons cost extra.
special_needs_notes: Children with developmental and behavioral needs are integrated into regular groups of 10. No 1:1 support, but staff check in and give extra support; ABAs may accompany campers after a background check.
